scope: Additive static hi-fi archive and responsive design acceptance reference for populated NH01 Normal Home. Does not replace original NH01 V1 raster, current Gemini Adaptive V2 runtime authority, or Android acceptance evidence.
source_of_truth: This contract owns the five static artifact identities, target viewport labels, visible static preview rules, the M05 480dp-width extension, the Design Manager presentation, and NH01 Responsive Foundation V1. The foundation adds A/B/C grouping and a 2:1 allocation of positive long-screen surplus to the final A-to-B and B-to-C gaps; the existing stats_to_title and card_to_footer formulas remain base-gap policy. It does not replace the original NH01 V1 raster, Gemini Adaptive V2 numeric constraints outside this explicit scope, or Android acceptance evidence.

foundation_layout_principles.scope: A/B/C group structure and allocation of positive long-screen surplus only; other Adaptive V2.2 numeric constraints remain binding.

groups.name: Top-information allocation band
members: three home statistics in a second row

groups.name: Catch-content allocation band
members: Recent Catch heading and All action
groups.layout_note: Recent Catch heading may remain physically in the existing Top Compose region while logically belonging to allocation band B.

foundation_layout_principles.safe_height: Actual usable content height after applying system insets exactly once.
foundation_layout_principles.group_height_measurement: hA/hB/hC are logical allocation-band heights, not Compose-container bounds. hA includes brand/avatar and statistics; hB includes Recent Catch heading, internal Title-to-Hero gap and Hero/Pager; hC includes CTA, camera and existing Footer internals. All exclude A-to-B and B-to-C inter-band gaps.

base_gaps.a_to_b: Existing Adaptive V2.2 stats_to_title formula; retained as base-gap policy.
base_gaps.b_to_c: Existing Adaptive V2.2 card_to_footer formula; retained as base-gap policy.

foundation_layout_principles.allocation_rule: The 2:1 ratio applies to added surplus, not final visible gaps. It explicitly supersedes the final output of the two inter-group gap formulas only when S>0; it does not alter the internal Title-to-Hero gap or its four explicit viewport targets.

order: compress A-to-B and B-to-C gaps within existing short-screen constraints
resize Hero only within existing ratio/size/readability constraints
preserve: existing Hero limits and 124dp short-screen exception

foundation_layout_principles.conflict_rule: If constraints cannot be jointly satisfied, report SPEC_CONFLICT; do not silently override other frozen numeric constraints or claim runtime PASS.

raster_mapping.rule: Target dp viewport labels and static PNG canvas pixels are separate measurements. Never infer one from the other or resample a frozen PNG to claim a different source canvas. M05 PNG aspect ratio does not establish an Android window height.

page_structure: Morning Lake background behind the complete home composition.
Brand title artwork, profile avatar, and three home statistics.
Recent Catch heading and All entry.
Selected central catch Hero with real left/right Peek cards only when real adjacent FishRecords exist.
Species name, positive length/weight values, time, and optional location, with time taking precedence over optional location.
Record-next-catch CTA and primary camera control as one bottom action group.
System top/bottom safe areas; controls remain inside the usable content bounds.

responsive_monotonicity.comparison_condition: Compare at the same system fontScale and layout variant while safe viewport width and/or height increase.
responsive_monotonicity.key_rule: Key text roles, selected Hero width, and camera visual size must not decrease as viewport dimensions grow. They may remain level at their defined caps.
responsive_monotonicity.font_base_formula: clamp(safeHeightDp * role_ratio, role_min_sp, role_max_sp) * viewportScale; emitted as Compose sp.
responsive_monotonicity.forbidden: No legacy inverse rule where a taller/larger viewport makes a key font, Hero, or camera visual smaller; no global font shrinking to conceal overflow.

peek.wrap: finite stable-ID pager; never create phantom or cloned adjacent cards

hero_and_peek.single_record: With one FishRecord, center the single Hero at the standard main-card size and show no fake neighbor or pager hint.
hero_and_peek.metadata_overflow: Preserve time; shorten or ellipsize optional location first. Do not leave a lone final CJK glyph or dangling separator. Species/auxiliary metadata may wrap to at most two lines where the existing Adaptive V2 rule allows it.

typography.font_scale_behavior: Compose system fontScale is applied once by sp rendering. The viewport multiplier above is a separate bounded layout scale. fontScale may inform gap compression, wrapping, and measured-height budgets; do not multiply system fontScale into TextStyle a second time.

roles.form: approved title artwork, not a text font
roles.viewport_multiplier: N/A to raster artwork; geometry follows existing avatar/header contract
roles.system_font_scale: does not resize image text as font

typography.overflow_policy: Compress nonessential spacing first; use only the local wrapping rules; keep text readable. Do not apply arbitrary global shrink.

camera_and_touch.grouping: Record-next-catch CTA and camera belong to the same footer action group.
camera_and_touch.safe_area: Place the complete footer group inside the usable safe bounds, avoid Hero/CTA/camera overlap, and apply system insets once.

spacing.title_visible_gap_definition: Distance from the rendered 最近鱼获 text layout bottom to the selected main Hero card outer top, measured in native boundsInWindow. Do not substitute the section Row bottom or Pager center.

title_to_card_targets_dp_at_font_scale_1.scope: static design preview only until an Android height is specified and Adaptive V2.2 formula is reconciled

existing_adaptive_formulas.stats_to_title: max(12dp, base - fontPressure*2dp); base=14dp if safeHeight<700dp, 16dp if <840dp, else 18dp
existing_adaptive_formulas.title_to_card_runtime: max(8dp, base - fontPressure*4dp); base=8dp if safeHeight<500dp, 12dp if <700dp, 18dp if <840dp, else 20dp
existing_adaptive_formulas.footer_bottom_padding: 2dp if safeHeight<460dp; else 6dp if bottom safe inset>=40dp; otherwise 8dp

spacing.extension_conflict: The M05 static target of 24±2dp is width-only and does not define safeHeightDp. Existing Gemini Adaptive V2.2 runtime Title-to-Card policy is height-based and caps its fontScale=1.0 targets at 20dp. Preserve both scopes explicitly; do not silently change runtime code or claim M05 native acceptance. Reconcile in a new Android contract only after the actual test-window height is defined.

required_adjacent_interval_measurements.bounds: bottom of visible brand/avatar header content to top of statistics row
checks: record actual dp gap and safe viewport
verify avatar/header does not overlap statistics

required_adjacent_interval_measurements.bounds: bottom of statistics row to top of Recent Catch text layout
checks: verify heading and All entry remain legible

required_adjacent_interval_measurements.bounds: visible title glyph/layout bottom to selected Hero outer top
required_adjacent_interval_measurements.reference: four existing V2.2 targets plus M05 static-only extension

required_adjacent_interval_measurements.bounds: selected Hero outer bottom to visible CTA text/control top
required_adjacent_interval_measurements.reference: existing Adaptive V2 cardToFooter plus footer top padding
checks: footer remains outside local Middle scrolling

required_adjacent_interval_measurements.bounds: CTA visible control bottom to camera artwork top; also record touch-target rectangles
required_adjacent_interval_measurements.reference: existing footer Column gap: 6dp compact, otherwise 11dp

required_adjacent_interval_measurements.bounds: camera visible artwork bottom to usable content bottom after system bottom inset
required_adjacent_interval_measurements.reference: existing footer bottom padding: 2dp compact; 6dp when inset>=40dp; else 8dp
checks: camera touch target remains inside safe bounds

priority_order: preserve required content and text readability
allow only existing local Middle scroll where contract permits
forbidden: overlap camera/CTA with Hero or system navigation
short_screen_and_safe_area.rule: If normal layout cannot fit the real safe window under the existing contract, report the appropriate failure state; do not label the viewport passed from a static image.

background_avatar_photos.background: Retain the existing Morning Lake master and NH01 Gemini route: exact immutable asset SHA 5fba741088ea186e898cd3bee5777e35978436f427492e6e6122528ef6aa91d7; TopCenter/Crop; no added tint, blur, or screenshot-derived crop.
background_avatar_photos.avatar: Follow NH01_Avatar_Visual_Contract_V1_1_FROZEN.md. The real-person avatar visible in any recovered static screenshot is sample content only, not the default avatar; do not change guest/login state, permissions, click destination, or user-photo handling.
background_avatar_photos.photo: Keep the true FishRecord photo. Preserve existing crop/Fit and same-source backdrop constraints. Do not fabricate neighbor records or treat static sample data as runtime data.

native_acceptance.execution_required: 24 real Android API 28 executions with viewport, fontScale, layout variant, bounds, screenshots, and logs recorded. Browser preview and static PNG review never changes NOT_RUN/NOT_VERIFIED to PASS.
native_acceptance.m05: Static 480dp width boundary only. Not a fifth native height profile and not part of the existing 24 cases.

change_log.change: Archive the five recovered original NH01 static hi-fi images; formalize target-dp to actual-pixel mapping; register complete responsive design acceptance; add the M05 480dp static width and 24±2dp visible title-to-card target with explicit Android-height conflict scope; keep Android NOT_VERIFIED.

Freeze A/B/C groups and define the 2:1 allocation of positive long-screen surplus to the final A-to-B and B-to-C gaps; retain the existing formulas as base-gap policy and preserve all other numeric/runtime authorities.
